title: One Piece
description: A story about pirates searching for the ultimate treasure.

title: Kingdom
description: Dramatizes the Warring States period of ancient China (475-221 BCE).

title: Naruto
description: Naruto Uzumaki, a mischievous adolescent ninja, struggles as he searches for recognition and dreams of becoming the Hokage.

title: Your Lie in April
description: A piano prodigy who lost his ability to play after a traumatic event finds his world regaining color through a free-spirited violinist.

title: Erased
description: A struggling manga artist with the ability to travel back in time moments before a life-threatening incident occurs is sent back 18 years to prevent a kidnapping.

title: Chainsaw Man
description: A poor young man becomes a devil hunter after merging with his pet chainsaw devil to survive.

title: Spy x Family
description: A spy on an undercover mission marries a professional assassin and adopts a telepathic daughter, none of them knowing each other's secrets.

title: Akame ga Kill!
description: A young villager travels to the Capital to raise money for his home, only to discover a world of unimaginable corruption and joins a group of assassins to fight it.

title: Jujutsu Kaisen
description: A high school student swallows a rotted finger belonging to a powerful Curse and joins a secret society of Jujutsu Sorcerers to exorcise it.

title: KonoSuba: God's Blessing on This Wonderful World!
description: After a pathetic death, Kazuma Sato is sent to a fantasy world with the goddess Aqua, only to find out that being a hero is much harder than it looks.

title: Prison School
description: Five boys are the first male students at an all-girls boarding school, but after being caught peeping, they are sent to the school's Internal Prison.

title: Plastic Memories
description: In a future where androids called Giftias have a limited lifespan, Tsukasa Mizugaki joins the Terminal Service to retrieve them before their memories fade.

title: The Disastrous Life of Saiki K.
description: Kusuo Saiki is a high school student who was born with all manner of psychic abilities, but he just wants to live a normal, quiet life.

title: Black Clover
description: In a world where magic is everything, Asta is born without any. To prove his strength and keep a promise to his friend, he aims to become the Wizard King.

title: Grand Blue Dreaming
description: Iori Kitahara moves to the coastal town of Izu for his university studies, only to get dragged into the hard-drinking, wild world of the local diving club.
